correctness.rationale: The exact law is uniform volume of a disk intersecting the centered lattice Voronoi cell. Its radial angular derivative is the complement of a finite union of angular intervals. The strict obtuse-superbase condition ensures every facet perpendicular foot is in its relative interior, hence a newly born forbidden arc has unmasked width 2 sqrt(2 epsilon/d)+O(epsilon^3/2). For 2m paired facets the angular derivative loses 4m sqrt(2 epsilon/d), while pre-existing interval endpoints are locally Lipschitz even at Voronoi vertices. Nonfacet radii therefore have zero square-root coefficient. Degeneracies of multiple facet distances and vertices are explicitly included. The attached verifier tests the sign, normalization, lengths and exact reflection identity, but finite tests are not the proof.

originality.rationale: The accepted statement is only the exact two-sided sqrt coefficient at every planar lattice Voronoi facet distance, with multiplicities and a proof that no nonfacet radius (including vertex collision thresholds) has this coefficient. Mémoli-Needham arXiv:1810.09646v3 Proposition 5.16 already claims recovery of a planar lattice-point set from qualitative critical radii; that qualitative reconstruction and the resulting isometry rigidity are explicitly credited and excluded from claimed originality. Their proof gives one circular-lens formula and qualitative collision counting, not the uniform facet-only sqrt coefficient. Kurlin classifies 2D lattices from the facet vectors but does not extract them from this derivative. The original 2018/v5 counterexample tori are reflection-isometric, proved by exact transformation. Search results did not locate a stronger quantitative theorem; residual priority risk remains.
residual_risks: Historical work on precise radial regularity of lattice Voronoi cell volume not fully exhausted; same coefficient could have appeared under a different terminology.
The exact-law singularity detection is not robustly quantifiable from finite samples without additional regularity/noise analysis.
Older preprint v3 partially overlaps the method through circular-lens geometry, although the accepted coefficient law and universal nonfacet-zero theorem are not stated there.

value.rationale: This is an exact quantitative local classification of which radii of a natural intrinsic distance histogram detect Voronoi facet births, and with what multiplicities. It yields a geometrically interpretable, collision-tolerant square-root signature and rules out fake signals at Voronoi vertices. These precise coefficients and no-spurious-vertex guarantee are motivated by reconstruction and provide stronger explicit information than the earlier qualitative first-three-critical-radius inversion; their value does not rest on claiming the already-known injectivity theorem as new.
